card.name: Words just before 'the' or 'all'
card.fires_on: The word 'almost' in 'for almost all drugs studied' in antidepressant suicidality text. Also fires on a few joining words or commas where 'The' or 'the' is likely to come next.

modes.label: almost before all
modes.description: The word 'almost' right before 'all drugs' in the pediatric suicidality warning.
modes.example: a tendency toward an increase in the younger patients for<< almost>> all drugs studied.

modes.label: Joining word before a clause
modes.description: A comma or 'because' that begins a clause, where 'the' or 'it' may follow.
modes.example: its sources remain unclear<< because>> it has insufficient inline citations.

card.writes: It raises English 'The' and 'the' and lowers German, Spanish and other foreign articles.
card.plain: It fires on a word where an English 'the' is likely to come next, mostly 'almost' in a standard antidepressant warning.
